messages:
Sam (CS): FYI Acorn Lane reported intermittent P95 spikes on chat generation during their morning batch window. renewal ~60d. Looking for safe, low-friction ops recs.
Ravi (Solutions): thanks — do we have model & region?
Sam (CS): on hosted redwood/gpt-large, FP16, eu-west. typical prompts: invoice extract + summary, ~50-100 tokens. P95 from ~1.1s -> ~3.2s at peak.
Ivy (SE): root cause candidate: periodic cron causing concurrent short bursts. quick wins: KV prefix cache, small batching tweaks, and an int8 canary for short requests.
InfraBot: automated insight: enable prefix KV cache + int8 pilot for <1500-token requests. projected cost -22%, P95 -28% on sampled traces.
Jo (Eng): propose pilot plan: 1) create model variant redwood/gpt-large:int8-preview; 2) traffic split 90% FP16 / 10% int8 for requests <1500 tokens; 3) route policy: if region==eu-west && p99_latency>2.5s -> fallback to us-west; 4) eval set: 250 invoice prompts; 5) auto-rollback if extraction accuracy drops >1% or error rate +10% in 24h.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll draft customer note with metrics + rollback SLA. Sam, want me to include an abbreviated slide?
Sam (CS): yes, include expected KPIs and the 48h feedback checkpoint. we'll also take 50 random prompt snapshots for QA.
Ivy (SE): implementation snippet for canary:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood/gpt-large:int8-preview",
  "routing": "eu-fallback-us",
  "metadata": {"tag":"acornlane-canary-7043219876"}
}
```
Jo (Eng): ensure streaming behavior unchanged and add trace tag so ops can filter. Infra will run auto-eval after 48h and post results.
Sam (CS): booking 30m kickoff with customer + Solutions tomorrow. thanks team.
InfraBot: scheduled reminder: run auto-eval at 48h and post results to thread.
